meta.name: visual-qa
meta.description: Runs rigorous visual QA across web, terminal, and paginated surfaces with screenshot evidence and a verdict. Use for any UI build or change, or when asked whether a page, component, or TUI looks right.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给网页和终端界面做视觉体检,附截图证据和明确结论
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果刚改完页面或组件,想确认视觉上没跑偏。
copy.tagline_en: Visually check web and terminal UIs with screenshots and a clear verdict
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you just changed a page or component and need to confirm it still looks right

howto.what: 对你做完或改动的界面做视觉验收：截取网页、终端界面或分页文档的截图作为证据，用脚本比对差异和宽度，再派两个只读审查代理并行检查，最后给出通过或需修改的结论。
howto.when: 当你做完或改动任何 UI、想确认它能不能算完成，或问某个页面、组件、终端界面看起来对不对时接管。没有可渲染界面（纯后端逻辑）时跳过。

say.text: 帮我验收这个页面，截图和参考图比一下再给结论
say.note: 跑脚本比对并派两个审查代理

say.text: 看看这个终端 TUI 有没有溢出或边框错位
say.note: 输出宽度与边框检查结果

say.text: 检查这个 PDF 的每一页排版，不要只抽样几页
say.note: 逐页渲染成图片再比对

howto.what_en: After you build or change a UI, Claude captures screenshots of web pages, terminal UIs, or paginated docs, runs script diff and width checks, dispatches two read-only reviewer subagents, and gives one pass/fail verdict.
howto.when_en: Triggers after you build or change any UI, before calling it done, or when you ask whether a page, component, or TUI looks right. Skipped when there is no rendered surface (pure backend logic).

say_en.text: QA this page: diff the screenshot against the reference and give a verdict
say_en.note: Runs the diff and two reviewer passes

say_en.text: Check this terminal TUI for overflow or misaligned borders
say_en.note: Runs a width and border check

say_en.text: Verify every page of this PDF, not just a sample
say_en.note: Renders each page to an image
